text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS games_played FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2030 AND player_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY total_points DESC, player_name ASC LIMIT 10
